description:
Title: Find a Job

You have to regularly report, to which companies you wrote job applications.
Based on your job applications, new potential job offers are sent to you.
Companies have to confirm that they received job applications and rate the application.
A job interview can be negotiated.
When a company wants you to work for them, you enter the probation phase.
After probation phase, you can rate the company and the company can rate you.
Reviews for a company can only be seen (by job applicants) after 1 year.
If a job becomes permanent, the process ends, unless you rated the company C or less, then you continue to receive job offers, but no longer have to report.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="https://example.com/bpmn/find-a-job">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Application" name="Job application"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ConfirmationAndRating" name="Application confirmation and rating"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_JobOffer" name="Job offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_InterviewNegotiation" name="Interview negotiation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_HireIntention" name="Company wants applicant to work for them"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ProbationCompleted" name="Probation completed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ApplicantRatingAndJobStatus" name="Applicant rating and job status"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FindAJob">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Job applicant" processRef="Process_Applicant"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_Company"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Application" sourceRef="Task_SendApplication" targetRef="StartEvent_ApplicationReceived" messageRef="Message_Application"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ConfirmationAndRating" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmationAndRating" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmationAndRating" messageRef="Message_ConfirmationAndRating"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_JobOffer" sourceRef="Task_SendJobOffer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveJobOffer" messageRef="Message_JobOffer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InterviewNegotiation" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateInterview" targetRef="Task_HandleInterviewNegotiation" messageRef="Message_InterviewNegotiation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_HireIntention" sourceRef="Task_SendHireIntention" targetRef="Task_ReceiveHireIntention" messageRef="Message_HireIntention"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ProbationCompleted" sourceRef="Task_NotifyProbationCompleted" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProbationCompleted" messageRef="Message_ProbationCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ApplicantRatingAndJobStatus" sourceRef="Task_SendApplicantRatingAndJobStatus" targetRef="Task_ReceiveApplicantRatingAndJobStatus" messageRef="Message_ApplicantRatingAndJobStatus"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Applicant" name="Find a Job — Applicant" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Applicant" name="Start"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendApplication" name="Send job application" messageRef="Message_Application"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReportApplications" name="Regularly report applied-to companies"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveConfirmationAndRating" name="Receive application confirmation and rating" messageRef="Message_ConfirmationAndRating"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveJobOffer" name="Receive job offer" messageRef="Message_JobOffer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewDecision" name="Negotiate an interview?" default="Flow_InterviewSkipped"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NegotiateInterview" name="Negotiate interview" messageRef="Message_InterviewNegotiation"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewMerge" name="Continue after interview decision"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveHireIntention" name="Receive company hiring intention" messageRef="Message_HireIntention"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Probation" name="Enter probation phase"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RateCompany" name="Rate company"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyProbationCompleted" name="Notify company that probation is completed" messageRef="Message_ProbationCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_AfterCompanyRating" name="Continue with review visibility and job outcome"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_WaitOneYear" name="One year passes">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDefinition_OneYear">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P1Y</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MakeReviewVisible" name="Make company review visible to job applicants"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ReviewVisible" name="Company review visible"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveApplicantRatingAndJobStatus" name="Receive company rating and job status" messageRef="Message_ApplicantRatingAndJobStatus"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_JobPermanent" name="Did the job become permanent?"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RatingThreshold" name="Did you rate the company C or less?" default="Flow_RatingAboveC"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Permanent" name="Job is permanent; process ends"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotPermanent" name="Job did not become permanent"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ContinueOffers" name="Continue receiving job offers without reporting"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Applicant_Start_SendApplication" sourceRef="StartEvent_Applicant" targetRef="Task_SendApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendApplication_Report" sourceRef="Task_SendApplication" targetRef="Task_ReportApplications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Report_Confirmation" sourceRef="Task_ReportApplications" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmationAndRating"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirmation_Offer" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmationAndRating" targetRef="Task_ReceiveJobOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Offer_InterviewDecision" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveJobOffer" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewDecision" targetRef="Task_NegotiateInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">An interview is negotiated</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewSkipped" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewDecision" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewDone" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateInterview" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewMerge_Hire" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge" targetRef="Task_ReceiveHireIntention"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Hire_Probation" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveHireIntention" targetRef="Task_Probation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Probation_RateCompany" sourceRef="Task_Probation" targetRef="Task_RateCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RateCompany_Notify" sourceRef="Task_RateCompany" targetRef="Task_NotifyProbationCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notify_ParallelSplit" sourceRef="Task_NotifyProbationCompleted" targetRef="Gateway_AfterCompanyRating"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ParallelSplit_Timer" sourceRef="Gateway_AfterCompanyRating" targetRef="Event_WaitOneYear"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Timer_MakeVisible" sourceRef="Event_WaitOneYear" targetRef="Task_MakeReviewVisible"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MakeVisible_End" sourceRef="Task_MakeReviewVisible" targetRef="EndEvent_ReviewVisible"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ParallelSplit_JobStatus" sourceRef="Gateway_AfterCompanyRating" targetRef="Task_ReceiveApplicantRatingAndJobStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JobStatus_Permanent" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveApplicantRatingAndJobStatus" targetRef="Gateway_JobPermanent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JobPermanent_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_JobPermanent" targetRef="Gateway_RatingThreshold">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The job becomes permanent</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JobPermanent_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_JobPermanent" targetRef="EndEvent_NotPermanent">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The job does not become permanent</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RatingCOrLess" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RatingThreshold" targetRef="Task_ReceiveJobOffer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The company rating is C or less</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RatingAboveC" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RatingThreshold" targetRef="EndEvent_Permanent"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Company" name="Company actions" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ApplicationReceived" name="Job application received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ApplicationReceived" messageRef="Message_Application"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CompanyWorkSplit" name="Confirm receipt and rate application"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfirmApplication" name="Confirm receipt of application"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RateApplication" name="Rate application"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CompanyWorkJoin" name="Continue after confirmation and rating"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmationAndRating" name="Send confirmation and application rating" messageRef="Message_ConfirmationAndRating"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendJobOffer" name="Send potential job offer" messageRef="Message_JobOffer"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_HandleInterviewNegotiation" name="Handle interview negotiation, if any"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendHireIntention" name="Tell applicant the company wants them to work there" messageRef="Message_HireIntention"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveProbationCompleted" name="Receive probation completion notice" messageRef="Message_ProbationCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RateApplicant" name="Rate applicant"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineJobStatus" name="Determine job status after probation"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendApplicantRatingAndJobStatus" name="Send applicant rating and job status" messageRef="Message_ApplicantRatingAndJobStatus"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Company" name="Company actions complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanyStart_Split" sourceRef="StartEvent_ApplicationReceived" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyWorkSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanySplit_Confirm" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyWorkSplit" targetRef="Task_ConfirmApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanySplit_Rate" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyWorkSplit" targetRef="Task_RateApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirm_Join" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmApplication" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyWorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rate_Join" sourceRef="Task_RateApplication" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyWorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_SendConfirmation" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyWorkJoin" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmationAndRating"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendConfirmation_Offer" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmationAndRating" targetRef="Task_SendJobOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Offer_InterviewHandling" sourceRef="Task_SendJobOffer" targetRef="Task_HandleInterviewNegotiation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewHandling_Hire" sourceRef="Task_HandleInterviewNegotiation" targetRef="Task_SendHireIntention"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Hire_ReceiveProbation" sourceRef="Task_SendHireIntention" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProbationCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveProbation_RateApplicant" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveProbationCompleted" targetRef="Task_RateApplicant"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RateApplicant_DetermineStatus" sourceRef="Task_RateApplicant" targetRef="Task_DetermineJobStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DetermineStatus_Send" sourceRef="Task_DetermineJobStatus" targetRef="Task_SendApplicantRatingAndJobStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendStatus_End" sourceRef="Task_SendApplicantRatingAndJobStatus" targetRef="EndEvent_Company"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
